analysis.title_zh: Higher-Order Pruning of Experts（HOPE）：面向 MoE 语言模型的专家剪枝
analysis.summary: 本文介绍面向混合专家（MoE）语言模型的专家剪枝研究，聚焦推理时专家参数常驻内存、但多数专家对单个词元闲置的瓶颈。[S1] 原文以 Qwen3.5-122B 为例：每个 MoE 层有256个专家，每个词元实际仅使用8个专家。[S2][S3] 专家剪枝旨在缓解这一内存瓶颈，适合关注大模型推理部署与参数压缩的研究者；但所给片段在方法介绍处截断，未提供 HOPE 的具体机制、实验效果或发布信息。
analysis.application: 建议：科研迁移可考虑将专家剪枝作为智能运维领域 MoE 模型推理内存优化的研究方向，并自行评估任务精度与资源占用的变化；这属于迁移设想，不是官方已验证效果。所给原文仅说明内存瓶颈及剪枝动机，未展示 HOPE 的效果验证。
evidence: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have enabled state-of-the-art LLMs to be scaled to hundreds of billions of parameters, but they come with a fundamental and costly caveat: every expert MLP must occupy memory at inference time, even though the vast majority are idle for any given token.
For example, Qwen3.5-122B has 256 experts in each of its 48 MoE layers, and 95% of its ~250 GB parameter memory footprint is taken up entirely by these expert MLPs alone.
However, for any given token, only 8 experts in each layer are actually used.
Expert pruning is one of the most direct fixes to this memory bottleneck.
